title: Step 2: Random Forest Classification - Visualizing Predictions & Results

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, so let's input the arguments.
cues.zh: 好，輸入引數。

cues.en: As you remember, the first argument was the matrix of features, the matrix of independent variables and that is training set excluding the last column,
cues.zh: 記得第一個是特徵矩陣，也就是自變數矩陣，所以取 training_set，排除最後一欄，

cues.en: which has index three.
cues.zh: 它的索引是三。

cues.en: Because as you remember, in the training set we have the first two columns which are the independent variables, age and estimated salary, with therefore indexes one and two.
cues.zh: 因為記得訓練集前兩欄是自變數 Age 與 EstimatedSalary，索引分別是一與二。

cues.en: And we have the third column indexed by three, which is our dependent variable vector purchased.
cues.zh: 第三欄索引是三，就是應變數向量 Purchased。

cues.en: So here, minus three.
cues.zh: 所以這裡寫 -3。

cues.en: Then what was the next argument?
cues.zh: 接著下一個引數是什麼？

cues.en: The next argument was why the dependent variable vector?
cues.zh: 是 y，應變數向量。

cues.en: And then here we'll take training set and let's pick it this way to specify the name of the independent variable.
cues.zh: 這裡取 training_set，用這種方式指定變數名稱。

cues.en: So dollar here and purchased.
cues.zh: 使用錢號，再加 Purchased。

cues.en: Purchased is the name of our dependent variable column.
cues.zh: Purchased 就是應變數欄的名稱。

cues.en: All right, so we almost have everything we need.
cues.zh: 好，需要的幾乎齊了。

cues.en: The last thing we need now is, of course, the number of trees, and that is entry equals 10.
cues.zh: 最後當然是樹木數量，也就是 ntree = 10。

cues.en: You can play around with the entry argument, you can choose many more trees in the forest.
cues.zh: 可以試試 ntree 引數，在森林中選更多棵樹。

cues.en: You'll observe some interesting results.
cues.zh: 會觀察到有趣結果。

cues.en: That's interesting to see what different teams of trees can do to predict the response of your users in the social network, whether they buy yes or no, the SUV.
cues.zh: 看不同樹木團隊如何預測社群網路使用者的回應，也就是是否購買 SUV，很有意思。

cues.en: But if you do this, make sure to pay attention to over-fitting, which you want to avoid.
cues.zh: 但如果這樣做，要注意避免過度擬合。

cues.en: You don't want to over-fit the random forest class for you to the training set, because if you do this then it might make some poor predictions on a new set.
cues.zh: 不希望隨機森林分類器對訓練集過度擬合，因為可能對新資料集預測不佳。

cues.en: You can actually check it out with the test set.
cues.zh: 其實可以用測試集確認。

cues.en: But here we'll choose 10 trees and we'll see what happens.
cues.zh: 但這裡選十棵樹，看看會怎樣。

cues.en: All right, so actually we're done with the template.
cues.zh: 好，範本其實完成了。

cues.en: We changed everything we had to change and now we can just, you know, select everything and execute to make everything ready.
cues.zh: 所有該改的都改了，現在可以全選並執行，把一切準備好。

cues.en: You can actually take some coffee or tea and you can just select everything and execute to watch the results.
cues.zh: 可以拿杯咖啡或茶，直接全選、執行，看結果。

cues.en: But let's rather do it step by step.
cues.zh: 不過還是一步一步來。

cues.en: We'll just do the first pre-processing step all in once.
cues.zh: 先一次完成前處理第一步。

cues.en: Here, so I just selected the pre-processing phase, and now I'll press Command or Control + enter to execute.
cues.zh: 這裡，我選取了前處理階段，現在按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: All right, all good.
cues.zh: 好，一切正常。

cues.en: We have our data set, our training set, and our test set.
cues.zh: 有資料集、訓練集與測試集。

cues.en: So everything looks fine.
cues.zh: 全部看起來正常。

cues.en: We have 400 observations in total, 300 observations that went into the training set, and 100 observations that went into the test set.
cues.zh: 總共 400 筆觀測值，300 筆進入訓練集，100 筆進入測試集。

cues.en: As you can see, the training set and the test set are scaled because in the end we are plotting some graphic results with a resolution of 0.01.
cues.zh: 可以看到訓練集與測試集已縮放，因為最後要用 0.01 的解析度繪製圖形結果。

cues.en: So in order for our code to execute faster and not actually break our code, we need to apply feature scaling to our training set and our test set.
cues.zh: 為了加快程式碼、避免出錯，必須對訓練集與測試集做特徵縮放。

cues.en: Otherwise, we wouldn't need to do that because the random forest classification is not based on Euclidean distances, but it's based on, you know, conditions on the independent variables.
cues.zh: 否則其實不需要，因為隨機森林分類不依據歐氏距離，而依據自變數的條件。

cues.en: But, because of this code here that is compute intensive we need to apply feature scaling so that everything is well executed.
cues.zh: 但這段程式碼需要大量運算，因此必須特徵縮放，讓一切順利執行。

cues.en: All right, so let's do this. Let's watch the results.
cues.zh: 好，看看結果。

cues.en: We just need to create our classifier here by executing this section.
cues.zh: 只需要執行這部分，建立分類器。

cues.en: So here, I'll just do this. All right.
cues.zh: 這裡直接執行，好。

cues.en: Okay, now let's predict the test set results.
cues.zh: 好，現在預測測試集結果。

cues.en: Then we have the confusion matrix, which will tell us in a flashlight how many incorrect predictions we have.
cues.zh: 接著是混淆矩陣，能立刻告訴我們多少筆錯誤預測。

cues.en: So let's actually do it directly.
cues.zh: 所以直接做。

cues.en: It'll be faster to see how our random forest classifier did well on the predictions.
cues.zh: 能更快看到隨機森林分類器預測得如何。

cues.en: So let's execute this.
cues.zh: 執行。

cues.en: And now let's enter cm here in the console.
cues.zh: 現在主控台輸入 cm。

cues.en: Press enter.
cues.zh: 按 Enter。

cues.en: And here we have our confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 這就是混淆矩陣。

cues.en: Okay, we have 7 plus 10 equals 17 incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 好，有七加十，等於十七筆錯誤預測。

cues.en: Well, that's not too bad.
cues.zh: 還不差。

cues.en: Just for fun, let's just pick another number of trees.
cues.zh: 好玩起見，換個樹木數量。

cues.en: Like for example, let's pick 500 trees. 500 trees is a lot.
cues.zh: 例如選五百棵，五百棵很多。

cues.en: That's a, really a big army of trees to make some predictions.
cues.zh: 真的是一支龐大的樹木軍團，來做預測。

cues.en: And now just for fun, let's take this.
cues.zh: 現在試試這段。

cues.en: I don't need to include this because my library was already selected from the previous execution of this code section here.
cues.zh: 不需要包含這行，因為先前執行這部分時已經載入函式庫。

cues.en: So let's rebuild a new classifier with 500 trees.
cues.zh: 所以重建一個有五百棵樹的新分類器。

cues.en: And now let's look at the confusion matrix.
cues.zh: 現在看看混淆矩陣。

cues.en: But before, let's build our vector of predictions because right now the y_pred vector of prediction is the one given by the random forest with 10 trees.
cues.zh: 不過先建立預測向量，因為目前 y_pred 還是十棵樹的隨機森林所產生的預測。

cues.en: So let's re-execute this. All right.
cues.zh: 所以重新執行這段，好。

cues.en: Now we have y_pred as the vector of predictions predicted by the random forest with 500 trees.
cues.zh: 現在 y_pred 是五百棵樹隨機森林的預測向量。

cues.en: And now let's look at the matrix of predictions.
cues.zh: 現在看預測矩陣。

cues.en: Remember with 10 trees, we had 17 incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 記得十棵樹時，有十七筆錯誤預測。

cues.en: And now let's see, select, execute, cm, enter, and now we have 15 incorrect predictions.
cues.zh: 現在看看，選取、執行、cm、Enter，現在有十五筆錯誤預測。

cues.en: Great, we invested 490 more trees to win two correct predictions.
cues.zh: 很好，多投入四百九十棵樹，換來兩筆正確預測。

cues.en: So, definitely that means that there are a lot of, and useful trees in the team.
cues.zh: 所以代表團隊中有很多沒發揮作用的樹。

cues.en: Okay, so as you want, let's maybe go back to 10 trees here because obviously 500 trees is not very useful.
cues.zh: 好，看你決定，還是先回到十棵，因為五百棵顯然不是很有用。

cues.en: Alright, so I'll just take that again, that as well and that as well.
cues.zh: 好，再選這段、這段、這段。

cues.en: All right. And now let's look at the training set results.
cues.zh: 好，現在看訓練集結果。

cues.en: So everything is fine here.
cues.zh: 這裡一切正常。

cues.en: We changed the title here with random forest classification.
cues.zh: 標題已改成 Random Forest Classification。

cues.en: So it's all good.
cues.zh: 所以都好了。

cues.en: We are ready to look at the graphic result.
cues.zh: 準備看圖形結果。

cues.en: And by the way, you can pause on the video now, and try to guess what you're about to see.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，現在可以暫停影片，猜猜將會看到什麼。

cues.en: Try to guess the shape of the prediction regions and of the prediction boundary.
cues.zh: 試著猜預測區域與預測邊界的形狀。

cues.en: If you understood correctly the decision trees then you would have no problem guessing what's about to happen.
cues.zh: 如果正確理解決策樹，應該不難猜。

cues.en: All right, so I'm going to execute right now.
cues.zh: 好，現在執行。

cues.en: Command or Control + Enter to execute and showtime.
cues.zh: 按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行，開始囉。

cues.en: All right. Wow, that's quite something here.
cues.zh: 好，哇，這裡相當精彩。

cues.en: So the points here are the real observation points.
cues.zh: 這些點是真實觀測點。

cues.en: That is the real users of the social network.
cues.zh: 也就是真正的社群網路使用者。

cues.en: And then we have the regions here, the red region and the green region, which are the prediction regions.
cues.zh: 接著是這些區域，紅色區域與綠色區域，就是預測區域。

cues.en: The red region is the region where our random forest classifier predicts that the user doesn't buy the SUV and the green region where a random forest classifier predicts that the user buys the SUV.
cues.zh: 紅色區域是隨機森林分類器預測使用者不會購買 SUV 的區域，綠色區域則是預測會購買 SUV 的區域。
